source.check: returned without a contest: the nominations gave contests only in Downpatrick Rural, Ardglass and Castlewellan Urban (Northern Whig, 4 May 1939, p. 10); re-elected chairman at the annual meeting of the new council, 7 June 1939 (Northern Whig, 8 June 1939, p. 8) (round 2, 7 Nov 2026)

note: Triennial election of the Downpatrick Rural District Council, polled at the end of May 1939. The two contested divisions, Ardglass and Downpatrick Rural, were counted on 2 June; Castlewellan Urban had three nominations, but two withdrew and Felix M'Kenna was returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 11 May 1939, p. 5). Filed on 1939-06-01, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1939-05-31 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Killinchy and Raholp are recorded from the report of the new council's annual meeting of 7 June 1939, with their divisions from the 1930 return (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). division inferred from the 3 May 1930 return (John Cleland, J.P., Killinchy); the council-meeting report cited names the member as sitting within six months of the election. Returned unopposed.
